cues: B. Resonance gives the carbon chlorine bond partial double bond character, so it is shorter and stronger.
The other points, the s p two carbon, the pi cloud, and the blocked mechanisms, all add to it.
Chlorine's electronegativity is unchanged, and chlorobenzene is a liquid with lone pairs on chlorine.
